title: DC Fast-Charge Share vs Target
dataSources: Tesla vehicle and charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smart EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, TeslaFi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / charger APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=evcharger:session
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(eval(charge_type="dc_fast")) as dc_fast, count as total_sessions by vin _time
| eval fast_share=round(100*dc_fast/total_sessions,1)
| where total_sessions>=4 AND fast_share>40
| sort - fast_share
description: Calculates how much of your charging month is coming from expensive fast chargers instead of cheaper home or destination charging.
value: Fast charging is fantastic and usually costs more; keeping its share visible helps you budget and monitor battery-use patterns at the same time.
implementation: Capture charger session type and count; review monthly and compare fast-charge share against your own cost or battery-care target.
visualization: Monthly chart of DC fast-charge share.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how much of your charging is happening at fast chargers instead of the cheaper slower options.
